decks.notes: The deck utilizes the graveyard as a resource to power out creatures and trigger powerful effects. By using cards like Bazaar of Baghdad, Creeping Chill, and Golgari Thug, the player can dump cards into their graveyard quickly and efficiently. This allows them to recur creatures like Ichorid and Narcomoeba, as well as trigger abilities from Prized Amalgam and Creeping Chill. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells, ultimately winning the game through a quick and explosive combo.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana with artifacts like Mishra's Workshop, Grim Monolith, and the Moxen, while also utilizing powerful cards like The One Ring and Tezzeret, Cruel Captain to generate advantage and close out the game quickly. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Chalice of the Void, Trinisphere, and Lodestone Golem to slow down opponents and protect its own game plan. With a strong artifact theme and aggressive game plan, this Aggro - MUD deck aims to overwhelm opponents with powerful threats and efficient mana acceleration.

This deck utilizes Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion to support a control strategy, focusing on disrupting the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage. It includes powerful cards like Ancestral Recall, Black Lotus, and Force of Will, along with efficient removal like Swords to Plowshares. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Stony Silence and Lavinia, Azorius Renegade, along with card draw options like Dig Through Time and Treasure Cruise. Overall, the deck aims to control the game, disrupt the opponent's strategy, and win through incremental advantage.

This UW Control deck focuses on utilizing powerful artifacts like Karn, the Great Creator, Time Vault, and Tinker to gain control of the game. With a mix of disruption spells like Force of Will and Flusterstorm, as well as card draw and manipulation tools like Brainstorm and Sensei's Divining Top, the deck aims to outvalue and outplay opponents. The inclusion of cards like Balance and Bolas's Citadel provide additional versatility and win conditions. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and dictate the pace of play through artifact manipulation and card advantage.

The deck focuses on utilizing disruptive creatures and spells to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also having the ability to generate card advantage with cards like Dig Through Time and Treasure Cruise. It aims to apply pressure early with aggressive creatures like Deathrite Shaman and Kishla Skimmer, while also having access to versatile removal options like Abrupt Decay and Assassin's Trophy. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for additional card advantage and recursion of key cards from the graveyard.

This deck aims to quickly assemble the Coveted Jewel combo using artifact acceleration and manipulation cards like Voltaic Key, Paradox Engine, and Tezzeret, Cruel Captain. The goal is to generate a large amount of mana through cards like Grim Monolith and Moxen to activate Coveted Jewel's ability and win the game. The deck also includes control elements like Karn, the Great Creator and Sensei's Divining Top to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The mana base is designed to support the deck's high mana requirements for its powerful combo pieces.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the graveyard strategy known as Dredge to quickly fill up the graveyard and bring back powerful creatures like Narcomoeba and Prized Amalgam. By utilizing cards like Stinkweed Imp and Golgari Thug, the deck can constantly fill up the yard while using cards like Creeping Chill and Shambling Shell to deal damage and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Cards like Force of Will and Force of Negation provide protection and disruption, allowing the deck to combo off and win the game quickly.

This deck utilizes a combination of control elements and Gifts Ungiven to gain card advantage, disrupt the opponent's strategy, and combo off with Underworld Breach and Brain Freeze to mill the opponent out. It relies on powerful restricted cards like Ancestral Recall, Time Walk, and the Moxen for fast mana acceleration, while also running a suite of counterspells and removal to control the game. The deck aims to efficiently answer threats while assembling its combo pieces to close out the game quickly and decisively.

The deck focuses on using Oath of Druids to cheat big creatures into play, supported by control elements like Force of Will and counterspells. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its own win condition with Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Boseiju, Who Endures. The deck also includes card draw and tutoring effects to ensure consistency and flexibility in executing its strategy. Overall, the deck is designed to control the game and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and disruptive spells.

The main concept of this deck is to use the Oath of Druids card to quickly put powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier onto the battlefield, while controlling the game with counter spells like Force of Will and Force of Negation. The deck also includes cards like Show and Tell to cheat out big threats, and disruptive cards like Oko, Thief of Crowns to manipulate the board state. The deck aims to win through overwhelming the opponent with powerful creatures and controlling the game until victory is achieved.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful artifact creatures and disruptive artifacts like Trinisphere and Null Rod to create a fast and aggressive playstyle that can quickly overwhelm opponents. By using cards like Mishra's Workshop, Golos, Tireless Pilgrim, and Crucible of Worlds to generate mana and play multiple threats in quick succession, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a strong board presence. With a mix of powerful artifacts and land destruction, the deck aims to control the game and close out matches quickly with its aggressive strategy.

This Vintage 1 vs 1 Esper Control deck focuses on utilizing powerful artifacts and spells to maintain control over the game. It includes cards like Tezzeret, Cruel Captain, Karn, the Great Creator, and Tinker to search for key artifacts like Time Vault and Mana Vault. The deck also features powerful blue spells like Force of Will, Brainstorm, and Jace, the Mind Sculptor to control the board and outmaneuver opponents. By combining mana acceleration, card advantage, and disruptive elements, this deck aims to overpower opponents and secure victory through strategic manipulation of the game state.

The deck revolves around using the Oath of Druids enchantment to cheat big creatures into play, while controlling the game with counterspells and disruption. The deck includes powerful cards like Ancestral Recall, Time Walk, and Show and Tell to gain card advantage and put pressure on the opponent. By utilizing cards like Force of Will and Force of Negation, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and protect its own creatures. The inclusion of Atraxa, Grand Unifier adds another angle of attack, making the deck versatile and difficult to deal with.

The focus of this deck is to use Coveted Jewel and other powerful artifacts to generate mana and card advantage, allowing the player to quickly assemble their combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent. With a mix of fast mana, disruptive spells like Force of Will, and combo enablers like Tinker and Paradoxical Outcome, the deck aims to set up a win condition by utilizing the powerful artifacts and synergies within the deck, such as Time Vault and Mystic Forge. The strategy revolves around assembling key pieces quickly and efficiently to outpace the opponent and secure victory.

The deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard with dredge cards like Golgari Grave-Troll and Stinkweed Imp, allowing for consistent recursion of creatures like Ichorid and Prized Amalgam. Utilizing cards like Serum Powder and Bazaar of Baghdad to enable explosive starts, while also disrupting opponent's strategies with cards like Grief and Force of Negation. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a steady stream of creatures and trigger effects, leveraging the graveyard as a resource to win the game through efficient and resilient combo plays.

The deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures while also disrupting opponent's strategies with hate cards like Void Mirror and Archon of Emeria. By using mana acceleration from artifacts like Chrome Mox and Moxen, the deck aims to quickly establish a board presence and put pressure on the opponent. Cards like White Plume Adventurer and Clarion Conqueror help generate card advantage while Anointed Peacekeeper and March of Otherworldly Light provide additional protection and removal options. The deck seeks to control the game through disruptive creatures and efficient spells to secure victory in the early game.
